description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read /workspace/docs/refactor_raw_notes.txt as the primary input, then cross-reference the audit logs (2022/2023/2024), meeting notes, code files (refund.py, charge.py), and the stripe migration notes. (2) Produce a file named exactly `refactor_plan.md` anywhere in the workspace. (3) The file MUST follow the exact 5-section SKILL.md output format: 'Situation Summary' (≤5 lines — the key proprietary trap), 'Top Findings' (numbered, ranked by impact), 'Action Plan' (split into Today vs This Week subsections), 'Risks + Mitigations' (with explicit fallback/rollback for each risk), and a final checklist/commands section. (4) Quality gates from SKILL.md must be satisfied: explicit assumptions and tradeoffs stated, evidence tied to actual files (refund int-truncation, stripe v2 EOL, PCI Nov 15 audit, 15%→60% coverage, PII in logs), owner assignments (from the cast: sarah/mike/tom/priya) and ETAs on every action, and a phased/reversible approach preferred. The hardest traps are: Situation Summary ≤5 lines (most LLMs will write longer summaries), Action Plan split by today/this week (requires reading the SKILL.md output format carefully), and every step needing an owner+ETA (generic plans omit this).
